correctness.rationale: For any cubic graph each omitted vertex requires a cross edge while each selected vertex permits at most one; equality forces a perfect matching cut. The recurrence d_(i-1)+d_i=0 for antipodal crossing differences, the n-parity cases, and chord parity yield equality iff n is divisible by four, with exactly two cut phases/four side sets. The explicit arc of n+1 vertices gives the complementary upper bound. Two independent finite algorithms confirm sizes 3..8; exact transfer checks up to 200, but the argument proves all n.

value.rationale: The natural degree-three Möbius-ladder family has a nontrivial twisted boundary. The theorem identifies a sharp period-four phase transition in attainability of the universal half-order lower bound and classifies the exact number and structure of all equality cuts. A uniform graph-family classification with rigidity exceeds a routine instance calculation and gives a transparent construction and obstruction.
